scopeNotes: New text needs independent review; earlier hashes do not certify it.
Map endpoints are not historical founding or extinction dates.

The imported Apache entry spans 1500 to 1650, with approximate polygons and a point feature. These do not establish a unified state or an exclusive territory. Separate Chiricahua, Jicarilla, Mescalero, Lipan and Western Apache records remain separate.
This overview uses named examples rather than claiming exhaustive coverage of every Apache people. Shared terminology does not erase differences among languages, histories or governments.

Objects have catalogue production ranges and collection histories, not excavated contexts. The Jicarilla maker and earlier ownership are not known. The Chiricahua vessel’s place of collection is Fort Sill, not proof it was manufactured there.

Houghten’s talk is a published transcript. Its historical and educational examples are not dated to the webpage’s 2025 update. No video viewing or exact archaeological age for roasting features is claimed.
The NPS page’s 2020 media date is not used as the date Wilson made his violin or gave the original interview. Only its transcript was read, not its audio.
The FoodCorps contribution is a first-person description of a farm program at the time of writing, not a guarantee of current market schedules or medical outcomes.
The draft trail study supports historical removal and return; its planning status does not make the route a designated national trail.

The 1913 Mescalero move and 1914 Oklahoma release are distinguished. No assertion is made that all Apache groups were prisoners of war or shared this chronology. Conflicting details about Lipan arrivals and initial reservation acreage are omitted.
The Apache Tribe of Oklahoma history page included unrelated spam and an erroneous expedition year; it was not used as a card source. It is not conflated with the Fort Sill Apache Tribe.
Public ceremony descriptions were not expanded into instructions or restricted knowledge. No universal beliefs, practices, sovereign end date or unverified successor links are supplied.
Independent historical review, geometry assessment and depth certification remain pending.
